about.body: The N63 is BMW's 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 petrol engine, used in Land Rover applications from 2022. It's a BMW-sourced engine — not a JLR-designed unit — fitted to the current-generation Range Rover (L460) and Range Rover Sport (L461) as the P530 variant. The engine uses a hot-vee design where the turbochargers sit inside the V of the engine, which is a genuine platform characteristic that affects access to certain components during a rebuild. Our workshop capability covers this engine's specific configuration, including the 48V mild-hybrid system that accompanies it in all Land Rover applications.

byModel.body: The Range Rover (L460) uses the N63 in the P530 variant from 2022 onward. The Range Rover Sport (L461) uses the same engine in the P530 variant from 2023 onward. Both applications are petrol MHEV, meaning the 48V mild-hybrid system is present in addition to the combustion engine work.

compatibility.body: The N63 is a BMW-sourced engine, not a JLR-designed engine. Registration/VIN matching is required — different applications vary by tuning. The hot-vee design adds complexity to accessing certain components, which we account for when quoting and carrying out a rebuild. The 48V mild-hybrid system components vary by application and generation, so we confirm your exact vehicle specification before any work begins.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
